title: service-automation: a declared override in <base>.custom is the packaged flow — armed over the code package, rebound in one reload, one ledger switch
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P1, cut after ADR-0146's rewrite merged in #28295); follows #28390 ruling **A** (comment 6542177429: only the paired `<base>.custom` declares an override), not ADR-0146 D9 item 1's "or from any package in the closure", which that amendment narrows. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28405, #28410, #28409

Part of #28236 (P1, child **N-11**) · governs: ADR-0146 D9 items 1–3, Supersede rows ADR-0126 D1 / D4 wall 1 / §7.1 · lane: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-automation`, the flow view in `packages/metadata-protocol`) · size: L.

**Business reason.** Today changing HotCRM's flow means cloning it, and both copies run. With this card the customer's version in `hotcrm.custom` **is** HotCRM's flow: one run per change, the same switch, and deleting it restores the original.

**Measured (`75ecaf4ad8`).**
- `service-automation/src/flow-precedence.ts#resolveFlowPrecedence` ranks `package` (0) over `runtime` (1); `classifyContender` makes every stored row `runtime` whatever its stamps; the remedy printed is "clone the flow under a new name, or switch the packaged flow off" (`:306`).
- `metadata-protocol/src/protocol-lock-state.ts#declinesStoredRow` / `#isShippedFlowName` keep every stored row of a shipped flow name out of the protocol's flow view, so the `kernel:ready` / `metadata:reloaded` syncs (`plugin.ts#resolveFlowContenders`) never see one.
- `engine.ts:4511` re-binds a name in one synchronous step (`deactivateFlowTrigger` then `activateFlowTrigger`); `plugin.ts#resyncFlowsFromProtocol` withdraws names absent from the fresh view after registering.
- `engine.ts#packagedFlowOwner` reads the loader's set, never body stamps; the ledger is unique on `(metadata_type, name)` (`sys-metadata-activation.object.ts:189`).
- A flow row of a shipped name in a writable package is refused by `refusePackagedBaseOverride`.

**Wanted.**
1. **Declared rank.** A contender is a declared override only when its stored binding (the `package_id` the protocol read, ⛔ never the body's `_packageId`) is `<owner>.custom` (N-08's constant) and its body declares `overrides.package` = the owner — N-10's exported predicate, not a copy. It ranks over the loader's body. Any other declarer is undeclared and stays shadowed and warned.
2. **The flow view admits it.** `isShippedFlowName` / `declinesStoredRow` let exactly that row into the execution view, through N-10's served-override predicate. ⛔ No second predicate.
3. **One reload.** Every arming step (boot pull, `kernel:ready`, `metadata:reloaded`, the metadata-mutation sync) arms the override in place of the base under the one name. Deleting the override re-arms the base in the same step, never withdraw-then-re-add.
4. **Ledger identity.** `packagedFlowOwner(name)` still answers the base. One ledger row switches whichever body is armed; the toggle door, the §7.3 subflow guard and the `FLOW_DISABLED` consult treat the override as the packaged flow.
5. **Write gate.** N-09 lands with `flow` held closed (its Not here); this card opens it for the `.custom` declaration in that same gate. ⛔ No second gate.
6. The undeclared remedy names the declaration in `<owner>.custom` or a new name, not the clone.

**Tests.** New cases in `flow-name-shadowing.test.ts`, `flow-precedence-loader-set.test.ts`, `flow-sync-one-precedence.test.ts`: declared `.custom` row armed; a dependent's declaration or a body-stamped `_packageId` not armed. One record change fires exactly one body across publish and delete of the override. Ledger off silences the override and on re-arms it. With N-12, a run suspended on the base finishes on the base after the override arms (the epic check 「流程定制只跑新定义、挂起运行按旧版完成」).

**Not here.** Pinning (N-12); Studio "Customize this flow" (N-18); "new similar" (N-21/N-22); `action` override (D9, out of this epic).

**Dedupe.** Related, closed: #11665 (clone + takeover design), #12563 / #12028 (shadowing sentence, banner). Searched `flow shadowing`, `flow precedence shadowed`: none arms a declared override.

Links back: #28236, #28390, ADR-0146 D9, ADR-0126 §2/§7.1/§7.3, ADR-0009.
